save this articleAdd TODAY to GoogleBetween hosting family, setting up fun Easter activities, and getting all your chickens in a row for egg dyeing, Easter is a busy time of year.With all the chaos of preparing for Easter festivities, you may be tempted to order takeout rather than cooking one more meal.On those days when you just can’t bring yourself to turn on the stove, Chipotle’s made-to-order Mexican food is always a delicious option.Before you make a beeline for the burrito bowls, here’s what you need to know about Chipotle’s Easter schedule.Is Chipotle open on Easter 2025?Unfortunately, if you’re craving a burrito bowl on Easter, you may have to look elsewhere.According to a Chipotle representative, Chipotle restaurants will be closed on Easter Sunday.What restaurants are open on Easter 2025?Luckily, several other restaurants will be open for those Easter cravings.Arby’s: Most Arby’s locations will be open on Easter. However, store hours may vary by location. Check local restaurant hours here.Olive Garden: Olive Garden will be open on Easter Sunday during regular hours.Chili’s: Chili’s restaurants will be open for regular hours on April 20.Cracker Barrel: Cracker Barrel will be open typical hours on Easter.Sophie CaldwellAssociate Lifestyle ReporterAdd TODAY to GoogleMore TrendingKevin Mazur/WireImage/Prince Williams/ Getty ImagesKhloé Kardashian Says She Regrets Being in Lamar Odom's Documentary: 'I Feel Played'Trending / Updated April 15, 2026Rich Polk/Bravo / Bravo via Getty Images‘Real Housewives of Miami’ Star Lisa Hochstein Turns Herself In After Being Accused of Spying on Ex-HusbandTrending / Updated April 15, 2026Allen J.
